content: VSCodium rebrands VS Code by merging its own product.json over upstream's with jq in prepare_vscode.sh, plus placeholder substitution using APP_NAME/BINARY_NAME env vars inside patches. Overridden fields: nameShort, nameLong, applicationName (codium), dataFolderName (.vscode-oss/.vscodium-insiders), urlProtocol (vscodium), extensionsGallery.serviceUrl + itemUrl (open-vsx.org/vscode/gallery|item), updateUrl, downloadUrl, quality/channel, extensionAllowedBadgeProviders, extensionEnabledApiProposals, extensionKind, extensionVirtualWorkspacesSupport. Lesson: display name and machine identity (data folder, url protocol, binary name) are separate fields; forgetting the machine ones collides with upstream installs.
